Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us. That is about £350 up on last year. The park sets the fee so there is not a lot I can do about it.

Please can you get your share to me by 31 January into the same account as last year. The park wants everything in by then.

The weeks are as follows:

Pete and Linda 29 May to 5 June.
Me and Bev 5 to 12 June, handover on the 5th.
Carol Easter and a week in September.
Jan 7th to 14th August.

No clashes this year so we are all fine with that.

If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is absolutely fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just say the word and I will let the park know, no need to feel awkward about it.

On the shower tray Pete, I went up on 26 October and put a new one in, £140 for the parts. I am not putting that on the bill, it is done and sorted.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave, the park has complained about it again this year.

One more thing for ahead, the van is 16 year old now and the park want a condition survey on anything over 15 years before the 2028 season. Just so nobody is surprised by it, nothing to do now.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
